cn: 表演艺术——表演艺术中心。

en: I think I've got them all, but I'm not sure.
cn: 我想我全都找到了，但我不确定。

en: Home of the Metropolitan Opera, the New York City Ballet, the New York Philharmonic,
cn: 纽约市芭蕾舞团、纽约爱乐乐团所在地。

en: Shubert Alley, the center of the theater on Broadway, and Carnegie Hall, and Kennedy
cn: 舒伯特小巷，百老汇剧院的中心。

en: Center for the Performing Arts in Washington.
cn: 还有华盛顿的肯尼迪表演艺术中心。

en: And the Music Center in Los Angeles.
cn: 还有洛杉矶的音乐中心。
还有其他。我确实全都有了。

en: You have been working on this for some time, Richard.
cn: 你做这个有一阵子了，理查德。

en: I'm glad you feel you've finally put it all together.
cn: 我很高兴你终于觉得把它们整合完成了。

en: Oh, you think you're going to have a hard time getting the album published?
What do you think you're going to do?

cn: 哈维·卡尔森这个名字有印象吗？
哦，对！哈维·卡尔森！我记得。

en: He said I should call him.
cn: 他说我应该给他打电话。

en: He is the publisher of the Carlson Publishing Company.
cn: 他是卡尔森出版公司的老板。

en: He said they need a new book of photographs, and he really liked my concept.
cn: 他说他们需要一本新的摄影集，

en: So why don't you call him in the morning?
cn: 那你何不早上给他打电话？

en: Do you think I have enough to show him?
cn: 你觉得我有足够的作品给他看吗？

en: I've been through every section with you, Richard.
cn: 我和你一起看过了每个部分，理查德。

en: And now that you're satisfied with the performing arts section, I think you should show it
cn: 既然你对表演艺术部分满意了，

en: My family album, USA, feels right.
cn: 你说得对。《走遍美国》感觉不错。

en: I'll call in the morning and set up an appointment to see him.
cn: 我早上就打电话，约个时间见他。

en: Is it too early to call Mr. Carlson?
cn: 现在给卡尔森先生打电话太早了吗？

en: I'm sure he's in his office.
cn: 九点零七分？不。我确定他在办公室。

en: Mr. Carlson is busy at the moment.
I'd like to make an appointment with him.
He told me to call him about my project, Family Album USA.
cn: 他让我打电话谈我的项目，

en: I guess they're trying to set up an appointment for me.
Mr. Stewart, I just spoke to Mr. Carlson.
cn: 我猜他们在试着给我约时间。

en: He would like to see you, but the only time he's available this week is tomorrow morning at 10 o'clock.
Well, it's done tomorrow morning in a publisher's office.
Oh, it's so exciting, isn't it, Richard?
Well, finally, a publisher will see my work.
cn: 嗯，搞定了。明天早上在出版商办公室。
早上好。我叫理查德·斯图尔特。

en: I'm here to see Mr. Carlson.

cn: 请坐，斯图尔特先生。卡尔森先生马上就见您。

en: Mr. Carlson will be with you shortly.
cn: 正如我说的，他马上就见您。

en: Excuse me, Mr. Carlson, but Richard Stewart is here for his 10 o'clock appointment with you.
Like I said, he'll be with you shortly.

cn: 是的，卡尔森先生。是的，先生。

en: He's ready for you, Mr. Stewart.
cn: 他可以见您了，斯图尔特先生。
今早真是忙疯了。你好，理查德。

en: Thank you for seeing me on such short notice.
I hope you've brought your pictures along.

cn: 我看你带来了。我们直接看吧。

en: We need a new coffee table book.
cn: 我们需要一本新的咖啡桌书，

en: And a book of photos about the United States still feels right.
cn: 一本关于美国的摄影集仍然合适。

en: If you had to describe the book in one sentence, how would you do it?
cn: 如果让你用一句话描述这本书，

en: Well, I'd describe it as a book which is a portrait of the United States.
cn: 嗯，我会把它描述为一本……

en: The places, the people, mostly the people.
The things they do, the ways they live, the places they visit, the landmarks.
cn: 他们做的事，他们的生活方式，

en: These photos in your performing arts section.
cn: 你表演艺术部分的这些照片。
卡内基音乐厅，林肯中心。
少了点什么。你眼光不错，理查德。

en: You've got a good eye, Richard.
cn: 干得漂亮！好作品，理查德！

en: But before I can publish your work, I need to meet with my marketing department.
And you've got to do one more thing.
In the section on culture, you've included performing arts centers,
but you've left out street performance.
cn: 你包括了表演艺术中心，

en: The musicians, the dancers, in the parks and on the streets.
cn: 但漏掉了街头表演。那些哑剧演员。

en: Richard, if you go out and photograph street performances in the city, you'll have it.
The performing arts centers and the street performances.

cn: 表演艺术中心和街头表演。

en: If you do it, I'll publish your work.

cn: 如果你做了，我就出版你的作品。

en: When do you think you can return with street performances?

cn: 你觉得什么时候能带着街头表演回来？

en: If they're as good as the rest of these pictures, it's a deal.
You won't be disappointed, Mr. Carlson. Thanks.
cn: 如果它们和其余照片一样好，就成交。

en: Goodbye, Richard, and good luck. See you in two weeks.
cn: 你不会失望的，卡尔森先生。谢谢。
再见，理查德，祝你好运。两周后见。

en: So, if you like the street performance photos, you'll really publish Family Album USA.
When I say something, I mean it.
cn: 你真的会出版《走遍美国》？

en: It was two weeks, and I did it.
cn: 两周。我说过两周内能完成，我做到了。

en: The pictures you've taken are fabulous, Richard.
cn: 你拍的照片太棒了，理查德。

en: I'm going to show him the photos on Monday morning.
cn: 我星期一早上给他看照片。

en: I'm very proud of you. You really did a beautiful job.
cn: 我真为你骄傲。你做得真漂亮。

en: I know he will love the new photographs for your book.
Yeah. I really did do a good job, didn't I?
cn: 是啊。我确实做得不错，对吧？

en: Hey, you know, there's still some film left on this roll,
cn: 嘿，你知道吗？这卷胶卷还剩一些，

en: and there's one person I haven't photographed in a long time.
cn: 有个人我已经很久没拍过了。
理查德！我都没梳头。理查德，

en: It's not fair, Richard. I'm not even ready.
cn: 这不公平，理查德。我都没准备好。

en: I'm so glad you like them so much.

cn: 喜欢？它们代表了你最好的作品。

en: You do, payment waiting for you first thing in the morning.
And while you're here, I would like to introduce you to your editor,
cn: 我想把你介绍给你的编辑。

en: and I want you to meet the people in the art department.
cn: 我也想让你见见美术部的人。

en: I'll set up an appointment with the marketing team.
cn: 我会和市场部的人约个时间。

en: When do you think we'll be through?
cn: 你觉得我们什么时候能结束？

en: I can't wait to tell Marilyn.
cn: 我等不及要告诉玛丽莲！

en: I can't wait to tell Marilyn.
